agentPolicyIds.description: Agent policy IDs for agent_based deployments. Single-element for new-policy deploys; multiple for existing-policy deploys targeting several policies.

apiKeyId.description: Elasticsearch API key ID for push mechanisms (ecf). Set by the backend; used for key rotation/revocation.

attemptCount.description: Number of deployment attempts, including the current one.

authMethod.description:
Authentication method. Allowed values depend on the delivery mechanism:

- managed_integration: identity_federation | static_keys
- agent_based: static_keys (direct_access_keys) | temporary_keys | shared_credentials | assume_role

connectorId.description: ID of the fleet-cloud-connector this deployment belongs to. Absent for static-keys deployments.

deploymentId.description: Opaque deployment identifier; for AWS, the CFN stack ARN.

deploymentName.description: Opaque deployment name; for AWS, the CFN stack name.

description.description: Integration description from the Service settings step.

serviceConfigs.description: Stack-relevant settings (bucket and log group ARNs) per service when the stack was last launched or updated.

serviceIds.description: Service IDs active when the stack was last launched or updated.

stackArn.description: CloudFormation stack ARN pasted by the user post-launch.

templateVersion.description: ECF semantic version resolved at launch time, e.g. "1.10.0".

ecfStacks.description: ECF CloudFormation stacks launched as part of this deployment. Written by the wizard after the user clicks Launch.

globalRegion.description: Global AWS region from the Service Settings step.

instanceId.description: Instance ID: the service ID for an original, `<serviceId>__dup-<n>` for a duplicate.

isDuplicate.description: Whether the instance is a duplicate of another service.

name.description: Display name of the instance. Duplicates use the custom name entered when the instance was duplicated.

serviceId.description: ID of the service this instance belongs to.

instances.description: Service instances, including duplicates, from the last deployment. Used to restore the service list when an onboarding is resumed.

integrationName.description: Integration name as entered in the Service settings step, before any per-package suffix is applied.

namespace.description: Global data stream namespace from the Service settings step. When omitted, an agent-based deployment inherits the agent policy namespace, other deployment methods use the default namespace.

packagePolicyIds.description: Package policy IDs created for this deployment (managed_integration and agent_based).

policyIdsByInstance.description: instanceId → policyId mapping persisted after deploy. Hydrated into the wizard on resume to enable cleanup of stale policies when services are removed.

services.description: Service IDs covered by this deployment.

serviceVars.description: Per-service config keyed by instance ID. Each value is the ServiceVars object from the Service Settings step.

statusMessage.description: Error context when status is failed.
